prompts.name: Pixel-v1
Byte
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a single transparent PNG sprite review sheet for Storm OS. Input image 1 is the exact owner-approved character design, not a loose inspiration. Make a 3 by 3 sheet with nine full-body states of exactly this character, equal cells, consistent visual scale, generous clear transparent margins. Reading order: neutral, happy, eating, playing, sleeping, waking/stretching, hungry/sad, tired, neutral blink. Retain the reference silhouette, palette, proportions and signature details. Keep every figure inside its own cell. Crisp blocky pixel art, consistent pixels/shading, clean alpha edges. No text, labels, numbering, cell borders, opaque background, checkerboard drawing, grey halos, smoke, fuzzy glow, scattered raster noise or unrelated stickers. Only a small simple bowl is permitted for the eating state; no other new props. Actual transparent background. These are review states, not UI. Byte is the SAME bright green rounded slime with large dark eyes, small mouth and yellow-green highlight in the reference. Maintain its green colors and rounded stepped body, don't add legs, ears or hands. Change eye/mouth expression and gently squash/stretch for reactions; keep the same overall volume. Sleep and blink close its eyes. Reference's detached sparkles may be omitted for this clean character-only sheet.

prompts.name: Pixel-clean
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, a 3x3 Pixel cat sprite sheet; image 2 is the approved original cat for identity. Change ONLY cleanliness of the background and unwanted decorations: remove every gray fuzzy patch, stray pixel cloud, colored sticker, sparkle, colored ring and sleep symbol outside the cats. Keep exactly the same nine cats, expressions, poses, order, proportions, white/orange/pink/blue palette and 3x3 placement. Keep the simple food bowl in the eating cell. Preserve crisp pixel-art outlines and make all remaining background fully transparent, with clean alpha edges and no halos/checkerboard/scenery/text. Do not redesign the cats, add props, or change the sheet layout.

prompts.name: Null-clean
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction and precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target: a nine-state 3x3 contact sheet of Null. Keep ALL nine existing figures exactly where they are, with the same poses, masks, black clothes, skin tones, red hood trim and exact red swirl chest emblems. Change ONLY the background: remove all gray/brown/red hazy backdrop, glows, shadows outside the figures and faint colored clouds between cells. Every empty region and gutter must be completely transparent alpha zero; preserve the dark pixels inside each figure and preserve the small food bowl. Sharp clean pixel-art silhouette edges, no semi-transparent background veil, no new icons, no text, no new characters, no redesign, no rearrangement. The result is the same review sheet on a truly clear transparent canvas.
